notes.title: Hotfix for Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, a new patch (240mb) is now available.  The new patch addresses the snap turn on WMR headsets and now works with Steam VR (right trackpad)  Another huge change is that we have turned enemies into physical enemies which a lot of you have asked for since release.  You can now see the dark spirit, and sometimes you can see the entity themselves.   With the gospel of Eden you can see the entities all of the time.

Enjoy the new update and our huge Halloween content update will be releasing on the 25th of October!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30921236/07649abc0a51a19702a5beb92fde3d1664e1c6fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.99 released!

Improved Lighting
Made the game much easier in General
Enemies do less damage
Fixed collision issues on Demons
Player has more stamina ( teleport ) for sprinting

Changed some weapons and relics in the main game

notes.title: Beta 1.2 Relesed!
notes.content:
We have released a major new update, beta 1.2 is now available!  The update is 1.1gb and has a host of fixes, improvements and new content.  With our last build getting rid of some of the problems you guys where having, the new build is focused on fixes and content as we now have the final build we will be releasing with.  We have added the final content and improved the game in many areas.  We need the community to give us as much feedback as possible and report any bugs you find over the coming weeks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30921236/02a3a7592400449b58bb7e3f2d89e795055ac637.jpg[/img]

What has changed since Beta 1.11?
------------------------------------------------

Added Rogue-like Element - Each new game is now random between 3 different stories/objectives.  To make the game more challenging and diverse with every new game.

Fixed up the Dark spirit and demon problems

More Optimisation - Better performance (Don`t forget the minimum is a 1060 graphics card, we recommend a 1070/1080!)  

Added Ghost-Town Arcade Machine - Gives you free roam of the town with no enemies or objectives!  great for learning your way around!

Improved Lightning effects and Flashlights/Tac Lights

Fixed more Path-finding Issues

Improved Relics - Weapons

Fixed Up Stats board in the main menu

Fixed Screen on reficul Tutorial

Fixed weapon ammo count not glowing

Fixed Staff If Power - Positioning

Added Glowsticks again

Added more music and SFX



In general, the build is now more diverse and is a challenging survival horror game which is now more rogue-like.  We have given you the tools with the tutorial and free-roaming ghost town mode to learn what you need to better your chances of survival.   The main game offers much more replay value and we have focused on the main game in the update.  Have fun with 1.2 and let us know what you think!

notes.title: New Patch Available v1.10 released
notes.content:
Hi everyone, a new patch 1.10 is now available (334mb).  The new update features inventory improvements, performance increase and a fix for 3 sensor oculus users.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30921236/886c19ae10cc8fc00ccaab636e5e957666cf086d.jpg[/img]

Whats new in beta 1.10 ?


Revamped Inventory - added more pouches to the inventory which makes it suitable for left or right-handed.  See the tutorial for info on the new inventory.

Increased performance

Fixed Oculus 3 sensor height issues

Added more music thanks to Roland!

Added shotgun ammo boxes which can also be holstered

Improved Dark spirits

Misc Fixes and Improvements





If you installed the game before this update, then please be sure to do following if you get any controls, achievement, performance problems -


Go to your user folder in windows, make sure "show hidden files and folders" is enabled! This can be done by : 


Windows 7

1) Select the Start button, then select Control Panel > Appearance and Personalization.
2) Select Folder Options, then select the View tab.
3)Under Advanced settings, select Show hidden files, folders, and drives, and then select OK.

Windows 8 & 10

1) Navigate to the control panel. ...
2) Select Large or Small icons from the View by menu if one of them is not already selected.
3) Select File Explorer Options (sometimes called Folder options)
4) Open the View tab.

Delete the folder "ReficulGame" located in the Users/Appdata/Local/

Eg : C:\Users\******\AppData\Local\ReficulGame

This folder contains config files which were set up when you first installed the game. Some of these files have changed and you need to delete this folder so the next time you restart the game it will build the new and correct config files.

This is only for those who have installed Reficul Prior to this announcement!

notes.title: MASSIVE NEW YEAR UPDATE! HTC-Vive Issues Fixed and New content!
notes.content:
We have just launched our new 1.09 betas of Reficul. (1.4gb)    This new build has a host of improvements and new content based on our valued community feedback.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30921236/a09b966fc434d881cec9e550eb6e2b4f13c0f8b8.jpg[/img]

Whats new? in 1.09?

Fixed All Vive issues
Hand now back and working on Vive
The Town is now fully fleshed out
Added new weapons
Perfected Weapon Handling
Added new bonus game - Base Invaders
Made bonus games - Arcade games to make it easier for you guys
Fixed Misc Inventory Issues
Added SMG class - weapons, and ammo.  Ammo and SMG can be holstered
Improved AI - ALL
Improved Flashlight brightness and distance
Improved locomotion for Vive
Fixed pistol holster problems on vive
Added Random pickups with each new game in 80% of the houses
Added more effects and atmosperic effects
Revamed Main menu
Fixed misc achievements not working
Fixed Teleport Cooldown/Sprint
Ficed Misc teleport bugs
Made the overal game brighter
Added kots more to the storyline, clues maps etc
Made the game much better and creepier all round
New and Improved sound effects and attenuation
Improved Misc Textures and material
Improved hit effects for bullets etc
Fixed all 144 Doors
Added Vulcan Desktop Support
Added lots more pictures
Doors now have sound effects
Added more details to house interiors
Added more notes, objectives, and storyline
Added new areas to town, Churches, graveyard, motel, caravan park etc
Added lots of new details, cars, and other aspects.
Massive performance increase
Revamped Mumbling Dead Bonus game and changed location and story.
Fixed Gospel of resurrection not working
Added more Lore for relics, spirits, and demons
Fixed Silver Bullets not killing demons
Improved flares, flares can now be holstered
Added more gun sounds to make weapons more unique
Improved tutorial
Chopped game size from 26 gb to 13.6 gb
Lots of fixes, Improvements and new content

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30921236/886c19ae10cc8fc00ccaab636e5e957666cf086d.jpg[/img]

With the new update, many issues have been fixed and controls have changed.  The first time you load up the new update you will have to play the tutorial again.  be sure to observe all the changes in the tutorial before starting the game.  We now have the full town in the game.

We still have more work to do on the mumbling dead game and we will be including our final bonus game - apocalypse simulator in the final content update next month.

Please report any bugs you find in the game, bugs should be very few and far between.  thanks for p[laying and have fun with the awesome new huge update.

Increased time delay in full locomotion
Fixed up Misc Door Issues
Fixed up misc clipping issues
Fixed Misc Inventory save bugs


As our dev vive is not working, we can not test these crucial changes and improvements for vive, so please let us know how you get on with the changes and locomotion options.  We hope to be able to get a working vive next year.

With the new locomotion for vive and the forward locomotion, you will need to perform this step (deleting the old config data - to initialize the new one)  for locomotion to fully work on vice as well as other issues.


IMPORTANT
-------------------

Those who installed the game prior to release or if you had pre-release access, you may experience problems with locomotion and teleport as well as achievements. You need to follow this step :

Go to your user folder in windows, make sure "show hidden files and folders" is enabled! This can be done by : 


Windows 7

1) Select the Start button, then select Control Panel > Appearance and Personalization.
2) Select Folder Options, then select the View tab.
3)Under Advanced settings, select Show hidden files, folders, and drives, and then select OK.

Windows 8 & 10

1) Navigate to the control panel. ...
2) Select Large or Small icons from the View by menu if one of them is not already selected.
3) Select File Explorer Options (sometimes called Folder options)
4) Open the View tab.

Delete the folder "ReficulGame" located in the Users/Appdata/Local/

Eg : C:\Users\******\AppData\Local\ReficulGame

This folder contains config files which were set up when you first installed the game. Some of these files have changed and you need to delete this folder so the next time you restart the game it will build the new and correct config files.

This is only for those who have installed Reficul Prior to this announcement!

Eg : C:\Users\******\AppData\Local\ReficulGame

This folder contains config files which were set up when you first installed the game.  Some of these files have changed and you need to delete this folder so the next time you restart the game it will build the new and correct config files.

This is only for those who had pre-release access before Halloween
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks, everyone and enjoy the new update which makes weapon handling Just right!
